code2='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {c for row in grid for c in row if c != 7}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        rs = [r for r,c in cells]; cs = [c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c] = 7
        if len(cells) == 1:
            r,c = cells[0]
            top = max(0, min(r-4, len(grid)-9)); left = max(0, min(c-4, len(grid[0])-9))
            for rr in range(top,top+9):
                for cc in range(left,left+9): out[rr][cc] = color
        else:
            ra = range(r0+1, r1) if (r1-r0+1)%2 else range(r0+1,r1+1)

            for r in ra:
                for c in ca: out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
